_doc: TNPCB industry_type code -> the sector toggle it joins on the erode-rivers map.
The register (TNGIS generic_viewer:industry_cad_matched) prints each unit's type as
'<code>/<description>'. Sector is read from the CODE, never from a text match on the
name or description: a text match put Britannia among the tanneries.
Two code generations coexist (1045 and 1080 are both tanneries, 1040 and 1084 both
textile processing), and 1049 is printed for both mining and slaughter houses, so a
rule may require a word in the description ('descriptionHas').
Codes not listed here fall to the category's general toggle; nothing is dropped.
'treatment' rules leave the industry layer and join the treatment-plants layer.
